# The set of views every harness weaves (ENGINE.md §16): pi_weave natively, in Rust's
# tests and from the .wasm must give the same cells for each. `make test` compares them.
# A line: a name, pi_weave's flags (1: reduced motion), the view's 64 bytes in hex.
# These are not a picture to hold to (PLAN.md, Session 14's fourth box): only a set of
# inputs. Each was made by setting the fields the weave reads (the tick, the flags, the
# swing, bytes 48 to 54), not by playing.
